title: Ukwiherera munsi y'ikiganza ca kure
intro: Iyumvire ahantu heza ho kwiruhukira kure y’abantu benshi bamenyereye, aho ukwihebera Imana guhura n’itegeko ridasanzwe. Umusuku ari wenyene arasubira inyuma mu bugororotsi no mu kwizigira, ashigikiwe n’ivyo ataboneka. Hirya no hino y’uwo mutima hakoranira hamwe ibimenyetso biteye kubiri n’insobanuro isanzwe, mu gihe ukwongorera kw’amakenga kurindiriye hirya y’aho umuntu yiherereye. Niwegereze wumvirize, kuko ukuri kuri aha kuzorwanya ivyiyumviro vyose.
clues: Narihebeye gusenga ndi ukwanje, nshigikiwe n’ivyo Umukama wanje yampaye.
Naronse inkuru nziza y’uko Allah yantoye hejuru y’abagore bose bo kw’isi.
Naciye nsubira inyuma nja mu kibanza ca kure co mu buseruko, npfutse abantu banje, igihe impwemu yambonekera mu buryo bw’umuntu atunganye.
Nasamye umwana n’ijambo rya Allah naho ata muntu yigeze ankorako.
Narihanganiye ububabare ndi jenyene munsi y’igiti c’umusukoni maze numva ijwi rimpumuriza n’umugezi munsi yanje be n’amatafari mashasha yo kurya no kunywa.
Nasubiye mu bantu banje ntwaye umwana wanje aherutse kuvuka, mfata umuhigo wo guceceka, umwana wanje w’uruhinja aravuga ari mu nda kugira ngo ankingire nk’umusavyi wa Allah.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Yarongoye urugendo rwo kujabuka ikiyaga cacitsemwo ibice
Yarubatse ubwato kugira ngo barokoke umwuzure
Gusama inda ku gitangaza no kuvuka wenyene munsi y'ikiganza
Yamizwe n'ifi nini mu kiyaga kirekire .

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Yasambuwe n’inkuba kubera ko yaciye umutsi w’ingamiya y’ingore
Bahindutse inkende kubera guca ku Isabato .
Yaremejwe igihe umwana aherutse kuvuka yavuga mu nda .
